BODY.VAR: select * from RABAEV.RRL_PRIHOD_NAKLAD NAK where NAK.ID = 31187

TABLE.name: table_1
TABLE.SQL:
select ART.NAME Товар, PAL.UID_PALLET ПАЛЛЕТ, (PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO+PAL.WEIGHT_TN ) ВЕСБРУТТОИТН, PAL.WEIGHT_TN Вес_ТН, concat( to_char( PAL.DEFECT_PERC ) , '%' ) Отход , RRL_GET_MOD_INFO( MOD_ID ) ФАСОВКА ,
RRL_COUNT_KOR2( PAL.ARTICUL , PAL.UNIT_COUNT , PAL.MOD_ID ) КОРОБКИ
from RABAEV.RRL_PRIHOD_NAKLAD NAK , RABAEV.RRL_PALLETS PAL , RABAEV.RRL_ARTICULS ART where NAK.ID = PAL.PRIHOD_NAKLAD_ID and ART.ACTICUL = PAL.ARTICUL and NAK.ID = 31187

TABLE.name: table_2
TABLE.SQL: select ART.NAME Товар, sum( ((PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO-PAL.WEIGHT_TN ) *(100- PAL.DEFECT_PERC ) ) / 100 ) ПРИНЯТО , sum( RRL_COUNT_KOR2( PAL.ARTICUL , PAL.UNIT_COUNT , PAL.MOD_ID ) ) КОРОБКИ from RABAEV.RRL_PRIHOD_NAKLAD NAK , RABAEV.RRL_PALLETS PAL , RABAEV.RRL_ARTICULS ART where NAK.ID = PAL.PRIHOD_NAKLAD_ID and ART.ACTICUL = PAL.ARTICUL and NAK.ID = 31187 group by ART.NAME
